services.desc: Enjoy a MILWAUKEE DAY SAIL aboard Red Witch II, a traditional sailboat. Please note that one of the former boats in our fleet, "Tall Ship" Red Witch, was voted "Best Tour and Charter Boat" in Chicago in 2009, 2010 and 2012 (3rd overall) by prestigious IlinoisMeetings+Events. See our reviews -- this is truly a memorable experience on a magnificent sailboat with a seasoned, informative captain and friendly crew. Duration 90 Minutes About The Sailing Experience We really do sail – once outside the harbor we hoist the sails, turn off the engine, and experience the magnificence of pure sailing on Lake Michigan. services.desc: Enjoy a PRIVATE or SEMI-PRIVATE sail for up to 6 guests (including you) aboard Red Witch III. NOTE: IF YOU WISH TO SCHEDULE A PRIVATE EVENT -- SEE OUR CALENDAR AT REDWITCH.COM. IF YOU DON'T SEE A TIME SLOT YOU PREFER, CALL US AT 312.469.0233. IF YOU PREFER A PRIVATE EVENT FOR MORE THAN 6 GUESTS, WE CAN ACCOMMODATE UP TO 28 GUESTS ON RED WITCH II (IN MILWAUKEE'S BEAUTIFUL THIRD WARD). Red Witch III is an exceptionally seaworthy, comfortable, fast and fun 6-passenger sailboat! Red Witch III is an "Islander 36" -- her sisterships routinely sail from LA to Honolulu, Hawai'i and two of her sisterships circumnavigated the globe. quotes.text: This is a hidden gem in Milwaukee. We were looking for something different to do on a date night, and found this. It was a perfect way to spend an evening. The views of Milwaukee are breathtaking. Captain had great stories and was very knowledgeable!

My husband and I were on the red witch. This was the most exhilarating and breathtaking ride. The view was just amazing. The Captain and his crew were exceptional. They provided us with safety and good service. Can't wait to do it again.

andrew and christian were great! very knowledgeable, friendly and outgoing. it was my first time on a sailboat but I felt very safe and had a blast! it was the best experience and I can’t wait to sign up again!

Sailed for the first time this afternoon and it definitely won’t be our last ! Great ship the Captain and First mate were amazing ! Very knowledgeable and friendly. Take the trip you won’t regret it !!
Such a unique way to experience Lake Michigan and our city! Captain Andrew is hospitable, knowledgeable, and gives you a real sail - even in low wind. Its smooth, easy and fun with him at the helm.
What a beautiful way to spend the afternoon. I’m so glad I had the opportunity and plan to go again. The Captain and first mate are all about safety first!!
